title: HistoryRevisionsGetRequest
description: Replay one entity at an exact revision (spoke-history). Requires the negotiated spoke-history capability; without it the connect gate answers op_unsupported / capability_missing. After admission, an unserved entity_kind answers HISTORY_ENTITY_UNSUPPORTED with details.entity_kind; a revision below the retained floor answers HISTORY_TRUNCATED with details.floor_revision; a revision at or above the floor that cannot be reconstructed answers HISTORY_NOT_RETAINED with details.retention_reason. History reads follow the selected entity's existing read and disclosure rules; a missing or non-disclosable entity answers NOT_FOUND. Read-only; no idempotency_key.

entity_kind.description: Open kind selector. Core vocabulary (documented, not enforced): knowledge_entry, relation.

scope.description: Scope in which entity lookup and disclosure are evaluated.
